spec.rawSql:
select
SUBSTRING_INDEX(it.name, ' - ', 1) as name,
MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '% - ONUs Autorizadas' THEN hu.value END) AS Autorizadas,
MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '% - ONUs Online' THEN hu.value END) AS Onlines,
MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '% - ONUs Offline' THEN hu.value END) AS Offlines,
MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '% - LOS%' THEN hu.value END) AS LOS,
MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '% - DyingGasp%' THEN hu.value END) AS DyingGasp,
DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(MAX(hu.clock)), '+03:00', '+03:00'), '%d-%m-%Y %H:%i:%s') AS ultima_verificacao
from items it
left join (select itemid, max(clock) as max_clock from history_uint group by itemid) as max_hu on it.itemid = max_hu.itemid
left join history_uint hu on hu.itemid = max_hu.itemid and hu.clock = max_hu.max_clock
inner join hosts ht on ht.hostid = it.hostid
where it.flags in (0,4) and it.status = 0 and ht.status = 0 and ht.host in ('$host')
and it.name LIKE 'PON %'
and (it.name LIKE '% - ONUs Autorizadas'
  OR it.name LIKE '% - ONUs Online'
  OR it.name LIKE '% - ONUs Offline'
  OR it.name LIKE '% - LOS%'
  OR it.name LIKE '% - DyingGasp%')
group by SUBSTRING_INDEX(it.name, ' - ', 1)
order by name;

SELECT
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(i.name, ':', 1)                                               AS placa,
    MAX(CASE WHEN i.name LIKE '%Uso de CPU%'      THEN hu.value END)              AS cpu,
    MAX(CASE WHEN i.name LIKE '%Uso de Mem%'      THEN hu.value END)              AS memoria,
    MAX(CASE WHEN i.name LIKE '%Status Operac%'   THEN hu.value END)              AS status,
    DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(MAX(hu.clock)), '%d-%m-%Y %H:%i:%s')                AS ultima_verificacao
FROM items i
JOIN hosts h ON h.hostid = i.hostid
JOIN history_uint hu ON hu.itemid = i.itemid
WHERE i.flags  = 4
  AND i.status = 0
  AND h.status = 0
  AND h.host   = '$host'
  AND i.key_   LIKE 'netstream.zte.card.%'
  AND hu.clock = (
        SELECT MAX(clock) FROM history_uint
        WHERE itemid = i.itemid AND clock > UNIX_TIMESTAMP() - 3600
  )
GROUP BY placa
ORDER BY placa;

SELECT ht.name host, replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(it.name, 'Interface ', ''),': Bits sent', ''),': Bits received', ''),': Operational status', ''),': Speed', ''),': Inbound packets discarded',''),': Outbound packets discarded',''),': Inbound packets with errors',''),': Outbound packets with errors','')
,': RX Power Avg Lane 1-4', ''),': TX Power Avg Lane 1-4',''),': RX Power',''),': TX Power',''),' Lane 1',''),' Lane 2',''),' Lane 3',''),' Lane 4',''),': Sinal RX',''),': Sinal TX',''),': Distancia','') interface,
MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Bits sent%' THEN hu.value END) AS 'bitsin',
MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Bits received%' THEN hu.value END) AS 'bitsout',
MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Operational status%' THEN hu.value END) AS 'status',
MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: Speed' THEN hu.value END) AS 'speed',
MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Bits sent%' THEN (hu.value) END) / MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: Speed' THEN hu.value END)*100 AS 'usoin',
MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Bits received%' THEN (hu.value) END) / MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: Speed' THEN hu.value END)*100 AS 'usoout',
COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: RX Power' THEN h.value END), MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: RX Power Avg%' THEN h.value END),MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: Sinal RX%' THEN h.value END)) AS 'rxpower',
COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: TX Power' THEN h.value END), MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: TX Power Avg%' THEN h.value END),MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: Sinal TX%' THEN h.value END)) AS 'txpower',
MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Distancia%' THEN hu.value END) AS 'distancia',

# Definindo os limites com base na distancia dos modulos e tipo de interfaces (Huawei e ZTE tem metricas diferentes)
COALESCE(
  (CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%xgei%' AND MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Distancia%' THEN hu.value END) = 10 THEN "0.00 a -9.00" END),
  (CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%xgei%' AND MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Distancia%' THEN hu.value END) = 40 THEN "-2.00 a -13.00" END),
  (CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%xgei%' AND MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Distancia%' THEN hu.value END) = 80 THEN "-7.00 a -23.00" END),
  (CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%ethernet%' AND MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Distancia%' THEN hu.value END) = 10 THEN "-1.00 a -11.00" END),
  (CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%ethernet%' AND MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Distancia%' THEN hu.value END) = 40 THEN "0.99 a -17.79" END),
  (CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%ethernet%' AND MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Distancia%' THEN hu.value END) = 80 THEN "-5.00 a -26.02" END)
  ) AS 'limiterx',

# Usamos como base o fabricante da OLT, a distancia do modulo, o valor atual de rx e os limites definidos para modulos de 10km, 40km e 80km (O valor e definido como anormal quando e menor que o limite lower ou maior que o limite upper).
COALESCE(
  (CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%xgei%' AND MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Distancia%' THEN hu.value END) = 10 AND (MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: Sinal RX%' THEN h.value END) < -9.00 OR MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: Sinal RX%' THEN h.value END) > 00.00) THEN "anormal" END),
  (CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%xgei%' AND MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Distancia%' THEN hu.value END) = 40 AND (MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: Sinal RX%' THEN h.value END) < -13.00 OR MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: Sinal RX%' THEN h.value END) > -2.00) THEN "anormal" END),
  (CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%xgei%' AND MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Distancia%' THEN hu.value END) = 80 AND (MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: Sinal RX%' THEN h.value END) < -23.00 OR MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: Sinal RX%' THEN h.value END) > -7.00) THEN "anormal" END),
  (CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%ethernet%' AND MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Distancia%' THEN hu.value END) = 10 AND (MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: Sinal RX%' THEN h.value END) < -11.00 OR MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: Sinal RX%' THEN h.value END) > -1.00) THEN "anormal" END),
  (CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%ethernet%' AND MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Distancia%' THEN hu.value END) = 40 AND (MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: Sinal RX%' THEN h.value END) < -17.79 OR MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: Sinal RX%' THEN h.value END) > 0.99) THEN "anormal" END),
  (CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%ethernet%' AND MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Distancia%' THEN hu.value END) = 80 AND (MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: Sinal RX%' THEN h.value END) < -26.02 OR MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%: Sinal RX%' THEN h.value END) > -5.00) THEN "anormal" END)
) AS 'staturx',

MAX(DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(from_unixtime(hu.clock), '+00:00', '+00:00'), '%d-%m-%Y %H:%i:%s')) AS 'ultverificacao'
FROM items it
INNER JOIN hosts ht ON (it.hostid = ht.hostid and ht.name in ("$host") and ht.status = 0)

LEFT JOIN (SELECT hu.itemid, MAX(hu.clock) AS max_clock FROM history_uint hu inner join items it on it.itemid = hu.itemid inner join hosts ht on ht.hostid = it.hostid where ht.name in ("$host") GROUP BY hu.itemid) AS max_hu ON (it.itemid = max_hu.itemid)
LEFT JOIN history_uint hu ON (max_hu.itemid = hu.itemid AND max_hu.max_clock = hu.clock)

LEFT JOIN (SELECT h.itemid, MAX(h.clock) AS max_clock_h FROM history h inner join items it on it.itemid = h.itemid inner join hosts ht on ht.hostid = it.hostid where ht.name in ("$host") GROUP BY h.itemid) max_h ON (it.itemid = max_h.itemid)
LEFT JOIN history h ON (max_h.itemid = h.itemid AND max_h.max_clock_h = h.clock)

INNER JOIN items_applications ia2 ON ia2.itemid = it.itemid
INNER JOIN applications ap ON ap.applicationid = ia2.applicationid AND ap.name = 'Uplink / LAN OLT'
WHERE it.flags in (0,4)
and (
  it.name like '%Bits%'
   or it.name like '%: Operational status%'
   or it.name like '%: Speed'
   or it.name like '%errors%'
   or it.name like '%discarded%'
   or it.name like '%Sinal RX%'
   or it.name like '%Sinal TX%'
   or it.name like '%RX Power%'
   or it.name like '%TX Power%'
   or it.name like '%Distancia%')
   and it.flags in (0,4)
group by interface,host order by interface;
